what_it_is: Grahaa Space is a Bengaluru earth-observation nanosatellite startup co-founded by a former ISRO scientist, building a constellation for near-real-time imaging. Its SOLARAS nanosatellite was deployed aboard Skyroot's Vikram-1 mission in 2026, an early demonstration of India's private launch-and-satellite stack.
india_angle: Grahaa's SOLARAS flight on Vikram-1 was a first-of-kind pairing of a private Indian nanosatellite on a private Indian orbital launcher, covered by Indian business media. The company is part of the first wave of Indian private EO constellation builders.
intelligence_assessment: The launch milestone is verifiable through multiple outlets; constellation funding and customer pipeline remain vendor-stated. Watch follow-on satellites and any IN-SPACe authorisations for its imaging plans.

faq.a: The SOLARAS nanosatellite, deployed on Skyroot's Vikram-1 mission in 2026 to test its satellite platform and onboard systems.
